definitions.entity_id: Exact gn:<geonameid> source identity; country source IDs map to metadata country:<CC> roots
definitions.is_preferred: Source 1 flag is preferred/official in GeoNames; not independently confirmed legal status
definitions.language: Explicit source language tag; never inferred from ASCII rendering or country
definitions.name: Unmodified source label or postal alias
definitions.postal_code: Unmodified source post alias, leading zeros preserved
definitions.relation: source_direct_id only; row uses source geonameid without name/coordinate matching
definitions.source_line: 1-based line in preserved country alternate-name ZIP member
definitions.valid_from: Original source from field; not automatically a parsed ISO date
definitions.valid_to: Original source to field; empty does not prove currentness

format: gzip-compressed CSV with header, LF line endings
